header.title: Submit Your Research
header.description: Submit your research paper to our conference and be part of the global exchange of innovative ideas. We welcome original contributions related to intelligent energy systems and sustainable computing solutions, offering an excellent platform to share your work with experts and professionals worldwide.

submission.title: Paper Submission
submission.description: We are excited to invite researchers, academicians, industry experts, and practitioners to submit their papers to SAGAR-27. This is an excellent opportunity to showcase your original research contributions related to Soft Computing Techniques in Renewable Energy Systems and Smart Grid Technologies to an international audience.
submission.stepsTitle: To submit your paper, please follow these simple steps:

steps.title: Prepare Your Manuscript
steps.description: Ensure your paper follows the submission guidelines outlined in the publisher format. Manuscripts should be at least 3500 words or 10 pages.

steps.title: Create an Account or Log In
steps.description: If you do not have an account on Microsoft CMT, please sign up. Existing users can simply log in to proceed.

steps.title: Submit Your Paper
steps.description: Once logged in, follow the prompts to upload your paper in PDF format and provide the necessary details for review.

list.title: Manuscript Submission
list.description: Authors are required to submit their manuscripts using Microsoft CMT in PDF format only.

list.title: Paper Requirements
list.description: The main content of the submission should be at least 3500 words or 10 pages as per the publisher format. References should be limited to 50 and the abstract to 250 words maximum.

list.title: Formatting Details
list.description: The text (12-point) should be typeset in one column. Provide 4-6 keywords. Vector-based figures should be provided upon acceptance.

list.title: Plagiarism Policy
list.description: Every paper submitted to SAGAR-27 will undergo plagiarism detection. Papers not meeting the policy may be desk-rejected without further review.

list.title: Review Process
list.description: All submitted papers will undergo a rigorous review process based on quality, originality, technical content, and relevance.

list.title: Publication & Author Policy
list.description: Only registered and presented papers will be forwarded to SPRINGER PROCEEDING. Altering author details or sequence after submission is strictly prohibited.

note: Note: The Microsoft CMT service was used for managing the peer-reviewing process for this conference. This service was provided for free by Microsoft and they bore all expenses, including costs for Azure cloud services as well as for software development and support.

footer.title: Ready to Submit?
footer.description: Join researchers and innovators working towards sustainable energy systems, smart grids, and intelligent renewable energy technologies.
